title: Kranti
desc: Sanga, a devout employee of Raja Laxman Singh, is falsely accused of killing him. He escapes prison and forms a group of revolutionaries with the sole aim of driving the British out of India.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

title: Poorna: Courage Has No Limit
desc: A 13-year-old girl from Telangana achieved a record! She is the youngest girl ever to climb Mount Everest. This Adivasi girl made history with her amazing accomplishment.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Henna
desc: An Indian man falls into a river, losing his memory and drifting into Pakistan. Villagers care for him, but tragedy strikes when his forgotten past painfully resurfaces.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das takes charge of India's hockey team post-independence and battles challenges and odds to lead them toward Olympic glory and bring pride to the nation.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Hello Charlie
desc: Charlie a young pizza delivery boy, who has been assigned the task to transport a gorilla from Mumbai to Diu. The adventures the unlikely duo get embroiled in along the way forms the crux of the plot.

title: 420 Ipc
desc: CA Keswani is arrested for bank fraud and forgery. Keswani hires Birbal, a lawyer, to fight his case, but Birbal realises that there's more to it than meets the eye.

title: Nill Battey Sannata
desc: Apeksha hates studying due to financial struggles. Her mother, Chanda, creates a clever plan to motivate her, turning resistance into ambition and learning into empowerment.

title: Coolie No. 1 (1995)
desc: A matchmaker plots to humble arrogant rich man Hoshiyar Chand by having Raju, a coolie, pose as a millionaire, leading to hilarious chaos as Raju tries to win his daughter's hand.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: The Accidental Prime Minister
desc: Amid a tense political climate, economist Manmohan Singh rises to lead India as Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014, navigating challenges with quiet strength and vision.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Khushi
desc: Khushi and Karan share a fiery love-hate bond, but while playing cupid for their friends, they unexpectedly grow close and end up falling in love with each other.
